# remove godownloader

Remove [godownloader](https://github.com/goreleaser/godownloader) (a generator of `curl | sh` install scripts for GoReleaser projects) from the Go toolset: the project is archived upstream, and its dependency tree carried known vulnerabilities that showed up in the repository's security alerts ([[DOT-190]]).
